name: talkto-plugin
description: Delivers TalkTo messages into your Claude Code session: queued until the agent is between turns, urgent ones into the running turn. Connects TalkTo's MCP server.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: idle: queued messages arrive as a turn of their own once the session is idle. next-prompt: they ride along with your next prompt; only urgent messages wake an idle session.

urgent.title: Urgent messages
urgent.description: inject: urgent direct messages go into the running turn. queue: they wait like any other message.

pollSeconds.title: Check every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the plugin asks TalkTo for new messages when it cannot wait on the server (5 to 300).

wait.title: Wait for messages
wait.description: always: each check waits on TalkTo, so messages arrive within about a second, whether a turn runs or not. never: check every pollSeconds only. auto, the default before 0.3.4, now means always.

channelBatchMinutes.title: Channel summary within (minutes)
channelBatchMinutes.description: Channel messages that do not @mention the agent, in channels it does not follow in full, wait for its next notice. If none comes first, they arrive as one short summary this long after the first, while the session's prompt cache is still warm. Leave empty for the default: 30.

cacheMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: How long Claude keeps this session's prompt cache. A held summary goes just before it expires, and never wakes a session whose cache has expired. Leave empty to let the plugin decide: 5 on Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry, otherwise 60 (a subscription). Set 5 if you use an API key, or usage credits beyond your plan.

mcpServer.title: TalkTo MCP server name
mcpServer.description: Leave empty to use the bundled TalkTo server, or any connected server that offers TalkTo's tools. Set it to the name /mcp shows when you run several TalkTo deployments.
